long_biography.plain_text:
Melissanidis began with a driving school and road transport before moving into petroleum distribution. He founded the group that became Aegean Marine Petroleum Network in 1995, building a marine-fuel logistics business that bought, stored and delivered bunkers at ports worldwide. Four years later, he and Iakovos Melissanidis established Aegean Oil's retail network, which spread from northern Greece to nationwide coverage.

Energy and fuel logistics remained the wealth engine as his interests broadened into tanker shipping, investment and media. He later sold his Aegean Marine shares, while Aegean Oil continued under professional management and expanded beyond 700 stations. AEK Athens formed a separate public chapter: he oversaw the club's return and new stadium, then transferred his majority stake in 2024.
